title: Stardew Valley
notes: Native Linux build 1.6.15 launched directly in an isolated profile from a prepared Year 1, Spring 2 save. Timing is realtime: the in-game clock advances while the model decides outside menus, so the game declares a process pause (SIGSTOP of the verified game process) and offers live and frozen-step Trials. Frozen steps last 2 s of game time, the input profile's step: 3 s steps would hold Jev movement keys for about 13 tiles, while 0.5 s steps would let a 3 h thinking-model Trial advance less than one in-game day, and evidence only appears when a day ends. Native saves are written only when the farmer sleeps or passes out, so evidence lags in-day progress and progress in an unslept final day is not scored. The ending is the restored Community Center. Stardew Valley has no difficulty setting; profit margin stays at the default 100% because the prepared snapshot uses it, the setting only scales sale prices, and lowering it would require a new snapshot without changing any bundle requirement except the purchased Vault bundles. There is no native death: exhaustion or zero health makes the farmer pass out and wake the next day, so Jev Trials run to the deadline. MonoGame samples input once per frame: clicks must be held (harness default 0.2 s).
introduction: Stardew Valley is a farming and life simulation. You play a farmer who has inherited a run-down farm next to Pelican Town. Each in-game day runs from 6:00 am to 2:00 am, about fourteen real minutes outside menus; sleeping in bed ends the day and saves the game, and staying up past 2:00 am or running out of energy makes the farmer pass out. Days pass through four 28-day seasons. Crops are planted, watered and harvested on the farm; items can be sold, and the town has shops, villagers, a beach, a river, a forest and the mines. The long-term goal is restoring the abandoned Community Center in town: its six rooms are restored by completing bundles, which are sets of specific items donated at the room's Junimo scroll, and the Center is restored when every room is complete. The run starts inside the farmhouse on Year 1, Spring 2 at 6:00 am with 500 gold, the starting tools and a 12-slot backpack.
controls: W, A, S and D move the farmer. C uses the selected tool or item; X checks, talks to or interacts with what the farmer faces, and confirms dialogue. The number keys 1 to 0 select toolbar slots. E or Escape opens and closes the inventory and game menu, F the quest journal and M the map. In menus, shops and dialogue choices, the left mouse button clicks buttons and items.
